response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack engineering experience with TypeScript and Node.js, and recent work on AI-agent infrastructure (including MCP) aligns well with the GenAI focus. However, his resume lacks explicit mentions of vector databases, RAG architectures, or multi-agent frameworks, which are key requirements. His background in AI-agent tooling is promising but not directly tied to production-grade GenAI systems as described in the job.
strengths: Extensive full-stack engineering experience in TypeScript/JavaScript and cloud technologies (AWS, Node.js)
Recent involvement in AI-agent infrastructure and Model Context Protocol (MCP) tooling
Strong leadership in technical domains (e.g., workshops, open-source projects, and mentoring)
concerns: No clear evidence of expertise in vector databases or retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) architectures
Limited mention of multi-agent system frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI) or their implementation
Background leans more toward general software engineering than specialized GenAI/cloud infrastructure
